notes:
Authorial page 24; the lighter foliation at the lower left is 48, and H’s archive page is therefore 48 for scan 49. The sheet gives a conjectural fixed-subgroup consequence for a rational point, asks about its relationship to the preceding body of conjectures, and then discusses model-compatible homomorphisms and inverse limits. These are the author’s claims and have not been mathematically checked in this reading. The opening appeal to a conjectural consequence is cancelled, with its inherited lexical doubt retained. The long vertical stroke is a margin rule, not a diagram or an enclosure inferred beyond what is drawn. Three rounded extension capitals are transcribed as script E; these alphabet-only rows are non-consequential. Both geometric-group letters retain C’s capital Pi as primary, with lowercase pi as an explicit graphical alternative. This is a new local doubt, not a case correction against C; the variable names are not inferred from their mathematical role. The relèvement connector retains a dash/arrow doubt. The visible opening quote pair by cons. is secure, while its scope relative to the insertion remains doubtful. The first fondamentale has a comma; modèles does not. The oblique note has no extra même. Its article and noun are tentatively singular, while risquent remains the first doubtful verb reading; no agreement is supplied. The blind audit identifies a short équivt.|équiv. form with a terminal stop. The final symbol is lim with a left arrow underneath, not the expanded word limite; it has no detached final period. In the lower paragraph the complets/complètes/compacts wording is unresolved, but its two long curves are insertion leaders to the gap after prenant, not separate parentheses. The cancelled de dim belongs before qui sont; schémas is separately cancelled and replaced above by modèles élém. The final addition is literally des imm ouvertes, without a dot after imm, and attaches before affines. No final punctuation is supplied after affines. The final line reaches the lower paper edge after affines without visible terminal punctuation. Line count records 21 main baseline lines, six marginal lines, four raised writing runs, and two number entries. All original/half reading was completed before the cropped review; the initially truncated crop batch was not counted as visual inspection.

[Blind audit] The isolated opening scheme letter gains V/U doubt and the crossed title gains local uncertainty. The long margin rule is represented with its slight rightward bow; this is a graphical refinement of the same rule, not an additional material text correction. The whole first formula was also reread on saved p02 (295,460,1679,590), because B03 begins low against the capital tops; its edge closing parenthesis remains uncertain. The retraced action subscript gains U/K doubt; both Pi/pi case alternatives and the relèvement dash/arrow alternative remain. The comma after Ceci posé is now locally doubtful. The quote placement beside cons. remains distinct from whether the pair is visible. The marginal inverse-limit reading and abbreviated equivalence are corrections made from the rotated crop, without a mathematical proof. The final paragraph has dotless hom, doubtful crossed de dim/schémas, and complets as the revised first reading of the small addition. The main anabéli- stem, the live avec, literal imm without a stop, and absence of final punctuation after affines remain supported. No mathematical check was undertaken.
